scope: Owner approved 88 individually reviewed candidates and rejected 12. Approved senses enter revision 20; rejected spellings are excluded from all gameplay roles.
sourceAttribution: Wiktionary contributors: fixed-revision links and concise adapted glosses under CC BY-SA 4.0. Georgian explanatory dictionary at ganmarteba.ge (Linguistic Technologies Group): source URL and content hash where used; concise editorial English glosses only, no full definitions reproduced. Previously verified fixed revisions were revisited in local source records. See content/dictionaries/README.md.
selection: Prioritize source-checked familiar noun/adjective senses with valid boards containing currently unused approved partners. Every candidate has a regenerated connected five-answer draft with four already approved words, seven tiles, two or more five/six-letter answers, valid crossings, density and phone-size checks.
limitations: Individual draft examples do not prove that all candidate boards or their unused companions can fit together under the whole-campaign 75-level gap, unique-wheel and pacing rules.
Partner counts are compatible options, not a forecast of newly used words or repetition reduction.
The search is bounded; candidates without an unused companion in the saved examples are not declared unable to help one.
Frequency data was discovery evidence only; no native-speaker review is claimed.
